text.p: Trading company and retailer Ceteco Holding NV said on Tuesday it expected an improvement in earnings per share.
"For 1997 as a whole, we expect a further rise in sales and income and an improvement in earnings per share," it said in a statement.
Earlier the company, which is mainly active in Latin America and which is 70 percent owned by Hagemeyer NV, reported 1996 net profit of 28.1 million guilders, up from 1995's 25.1 million.
Ceteco said it was planning to concentrate on strengthening its existing operations and expanding its market position.
"In Argentina and Peru, where our market share is still small, we expect to see strong sales growth, particularly in Argentina," it said.

In the company's traditional markets in Central America and the Caribbean, the emphasis will be on gaining further operational efficiencies. Some improvement is also expected from a cautious recovery in Colombia and Venezuela, it added.
Net sales increased by 49 percent in 1996 to 717 million guilders. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000
